breakdown.description: The varying traction is extended from the outer right edge to additional cutout surfaces selected by outward-normal orientation
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly resolved the conflicting instructions regarding the traction boundary. The incomplete prompt stated both to apply traction only on the outer right edge AND to apply it on all surfaces with a positive x-normal. The agent correctly specified that the traction is applied 'only on the outer right edge (x=1)' and that 'All re-entrant inner boundaries are traction-free', which matches the ground truth.
